title: Design the generic, system-agnostic combat/action resolution flow (attack rolls, damage, saves) connecting the already-proposed dice/modifier/turn-tracker/entity pieces into one concrete mechanism
objective: Owner asked to set import/export aside and focus on the game itself, asking for the next concrete step. This is the next unresolved item in docs/research/vtt-product-scope-map.md's Game system/rules engine bucket ('Rule automation: attack rolls, damage calculation, saves' -- previously Not discussed). Rather than new external research, this synthesizes the pieces already found (ndm dice-notation parsing, domain-core's existing DeterministicRng, the Active-Effects-style modifier system with its key-path + Change Mode + fixed application order, the Combat/Combatant turn tracker, and the ECS-style flexible entity model) into one concrete, generic action-resolution flow expressed as Commands/DomainEvents flowing through the existing Command -> DomainEvent -> Snapshot pipeline: a system declares an action with a formula string and a resolution rule (compare against a target key-path); the roll uses domain-core's own deterministic RNG (not ndm's internal RNG) with active modifiers applied in the established fixed order; success/failure is a generic numeric comparison agnostic to what the compared values represent; consequences (damage, healing) are applied as one-shot modifier Commands, using the exact same mechanism as persistent status-effect modifiers, just without staying active afterward -- meaning 'limitations' (ongoing status effects) and 'combat damage' are not two systems, they are the same mechanism at two different persistence lifetimes. This stays fully system-agnostic: the core only ever operates on formula strings, key paths, and numeric comparisons supplied by whichever system layer plugs in, never hardcoding what 'AC' or 'damage' means.
validations: Added a 'Combat/action resolution flow (generic, system-agnostic)' section to docs/research/vtt-rules-and-character-system-options.md extending its existing 'Proposed consolidated agnostic architecture' section: a concrete Command/DomainEvent sequence (DeclareAction -> ResolveRoll using domain-core's DeterministicRng with modifiers applied in the already-established fixed order -> compare against a target key path -> apply consequences as one-shot modifier Commands -> emit a generic ActionResolved DomainEvent), with the explicit unifying insight that damage/healing and persistent status effects are the same modifier mechanism at different persistence lifetimes.

Kept the design fully generic/system-agnostic -- no specific game system's formulas, stat names, or rules were hardcoded; the core only handles formula strings, key paths, and numeric comparisons a system layer supplies.
Updated docs/research/vtt-product-scope-map.md's Game system/rules engine row for 'Rule automation' from Not discussed to Standby, pointing at this new section.

This is a design synthesis of already-researched pieces (ndm, DeterministicRng, Active Effects, Combat/Combatant), not new external research -- no new WebSearch/WebFetch calls were needed or made for this task.
No dependency installed, no code written, no ADR reopened -- documentation design proposal only.
risks: This is a design proposal synthesizing already-recorded findings, not validated by any spike, prototype, or a real game system's actual formulas -- recorded as such.
No dependency installed, no code written -- research/documentation only.
